occupational-licensing.note: Draft 11 (18 Nov 2026): the owner asked for it on 17 November 2026 ("Licensing boards: professional licensure and the licensing boards"; her bench note on 2023-2024 SB 44, "More occupational licensure"). Title XXX of the RSA (Occupations and Professions) is its backbone: a practice act attaches alone; pharmacy (318), physicians (329), attorneys (311), veterinarians (332-B) and a few more only with a licensing word; the controlled drug act (318-B) and medical records (332-I) never. Health professions also carry Health professions and workforce. A licence to run a business or a facility (mortgage lenders, child care agencies, hospitals, liquor) is not in it.

boating-waterways.name: Boating and waterways
boating-waterways.definition: Bills about boats and the public waters they use: boat registration, safety and speed rules, moorings and docks, lakes, ponds, rivers, harbors and the coast, their shorelands, and invasive aquatic plants.
boating-waterways.note: Draft 11 (18 Nov 2026): the owner asked for it on 17 November 2026 ("maritime laws (Boats, oceans, lakes? there's probably a better way to phrase it)"). It takes the boats that were in Recreational vehicles, with commercial and fishing vessels, which Recreational vehicles left out, and the waters: lakes and ponds, rivers under the rivers management program, harbors and ports, the coast and the shoreland act. Dams only with a lake or pond word.

state-holidays.name: State holidays
state-holidays.definition: Bills about the state's legal holidays and holiday policy: which days are holidays, their names and dates, and holiday pay and closings.
state-holidays.note: Draft 11 (18 Nov 2026): the owner asked for it on 17 November 2026 ("declaring new state holidays or holiday policy"). The legal holidays are RSA 288, which attaches alone; a day the governor is asked to proclaim, and no holiday, is in Proclamations and recognitions instead.

proclamations-recognitions.name: Proclamations and recognitions
proclamations-recognitions.definition: Bills and resolutions that set aside a day, week or month to observe or to raise awareness of a cause, or that honor, memorialize, congratulate or recognize a person, group or event.
proclamations-recognitions.note: Draft 11 (18 Nov 2026): the owner asked for it on 17 November 2026 ("proclaiming a certain week as an awareness week of some form or recognition of someone/something"; her example, the 2027 request LSR 2027-0708, "declaring May 4 2027 as Star Wars Day"). By the title only: a day, week or month proclaimed, declared, designated or established, an awareness or appreciation day, and the resolutions that open by honoring, memorializing, congratulating or recognizing. A legal holiday is State holidays instead.

zoning-land-use.name: Zoning and land use
zoning-land-use.definition: Bills about how towns and cities regulate the use of land: zoning ordinances, planning boards and zoning boards of adjustment, variances, master plans, subdivision and site plan review, and impact fees.
zoning-land-use.note: Draft 11 (18 Nov 2026): proposed for the untagged bills (the owner, 18 November 2026: tags only where a subject recurs across terms and the matches are valid). RSA 672 to 677 (planning and zoning) and 36 (regional planning commissions) attach alone; RSA 674, which also holds the building code's local part, and RSA 36 only with a zoning or planning word.

building-fire-codes.name: Building and fire codes
building-fire-codes.definition: Bills about the state building code and fire code: the standards new and renovated buildings must meet, including energy and sprinkler requirements, and who adopts, amends and enforces them.
building-fire-codes.note: Draft 11 (18 Nov 2026): proposed for the untagged bills: the state building code (RSA 155-A) and the fire code recur in every term since 2001, and most such bills carried no tag.
